# Mehmet Cam

> AI engineer, product builder and applied AI researcher working across AI engineering, automation, data systems, AgriTech, research and production-minded digital products.

Canonical website: https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/

## Core profile

- Applied AI and AI-assisted product engineering
- Product engineering from architecture through deployment
- Automation and human-in-the-loop workflows
- Data and decision-support systems
- AgriTech, sustainable agriculture and rural innovation research
- R&D and Innovation Management master's background
- EU-funded research project experience

## Featured work

- [TourPilot](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/tourpilot/) — AI-assisted operations platform built around real tour-operator workflows, reservation ingestion, operational planning, auditability, RBAC and data quality.
- [Evalora](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/evalora/) — independently developed digital product exploring applied AI and data-driven user experiences.
- [OncoConnect](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/oncoconnect/) — technology-enabled health information and connected user experience project.
- [Search Intelligence](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/search-intelligence/) — interactive AI/search intelligence application.
- [Colon Cancer Histopathology AI](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/histopathology/) — portfolio AI exploration; not a diagnostic product.
- [ENRICH Triage Engine](https://mehmetcamofficial.com.tr/projects/enrich/) — applied decision-support prototype.
